description: Look up genealogy data from WikiTree, the free, collaborative, single-family-tree of the world. Fetch person and free-space profiles, biographies, and photos; walk ancestors, descendants, relatives, and nuclear families; trace the connection between any two people; explore DNA-test connections; and search the tree by name, dates, and place. Uses WikiTree's keyless public API. No account or API key required.
